decisions.reason: Active-ticket transfer changes resale ownership semantics, but it does not change the existing requirement that Small and Big Block ticket counters remain visible in NFT metadata.
Transferring active prize tickets does not change badge award milestones, storage, approved designs, or current badge effects.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records that the FAQ must explain that active prize tickets transfer to the NFT buyer, so no addition or edit is required.
NFT resale transfer of active tickets does not change primary-mint pricing or revenue allocation.
The no-referral recipient-selection and reward-allocation rules remain unchanged by later transfer of active tickets with an NFT.
Ticket ownership transfer does not alter the Chainlink VRF selection method, ticket weighting, or draw-specific eligibility windows.
The transfer of existing active tickets does not change the flat royalty, royalty allocation, pool funding, or rule that secondary sales create no new referral tickets.
Active-ticket transfer does not change Big Block prize amounts, winner count, pool target, draw trigger, or eligible sale types.
Active-ticket transfer does not change Small Block prize amounts, winner count, pool funding, or draw condition.

The source changes ownership of active tickets on NFT resale, while this requirement independently governs ticket issuance, eligibility windows, and post-draw reset behavior, all of which remain unchanged.
The source does not change the manual one-click prize-claim method or Winners-page claim location.
The active-ticket transfer rule does not change the product name or branding requirement.
